summary: Abandon the party at Harrowcross, repeat the amber trigger, survive the first wretch, and follow the evidence to Saint Orra Mine

turn.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turn.text: Show me the survivor's wounds before the room.

turn.speaker: char_7DS75TG6WFK6ZD1T9GCBJRMK1T
turn.text: The cold is inside them. I keep dreaming my hands belong to the thing that bit Bran.

turn.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turn.text: What was stored beneath the bunks?

turn.speaker: char_1F7JEGBD02MVY0J8M9X0967T5T
turn.text: Quarterly guild payment. Amber from Saint Orra, raw and struck.

turn.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turn.text: Any animal tracks around the barracks?

turn.speaker: char_1F7JEGBD02MVY0J8M9X0967T5T
turn.text: None. Frost on the inner walls. Splinters pointing into the room.

turn.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turn.text: So the door stayed barred, the walls were not broken, and the spears snapped inward.

turn.speaker: char_2YA8FQRX5Q0PRKSETNQZ4EEDKZ
turn.text: That is why the town paid for monster hunters before the caravan ever saw our gate.

turn.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turn.text: And that is why the emergency clause now applies.

recollection.summary: The guards died inside a barred room containing the town's amber payment; Maela intends to invoke emergency reassignment.
recollection.interpretation: The assignment was decided before the caravan reached the gate.

recollection.summary: The barracks has no animal approach tracks, frost on its inner walls, and debris driven inward.
recollection.interpretation: Whatever killed the watch did not enter like a living predator.

recollection.summary: Kellan experiences cold inside wounds made by something that borrowed familiar anatomy.
recollection.interpretation: The killer may be a suffering impression rather than an ordinary beast or ghost.

recollection.summary: The slaughter room contained mixed raw and refined amber stored beneath the bunks.
recollection.interpretation: The chest is a material variable the locals are reluctant to discuss.

recollection.summary: The physical evidence points inward: no opened door, no breached wall, and weapons broken toward the center.
recollection.interpretation: Locks and walls did not fail; the threat disregarded them.

recollection.summary: The new hunters immediately separated wounds, tracks, stored amber, and structural evidence instead of asking for a monster name.
recollection.interpretation: They may survive long enough to discover what his old report missed.

recollection.summary: The strangers believe the barred room matters and did not call his account cowardice.
recollection.interpretation: Garran may understand that the cold remains in him.

frontmatter.title: Harrowcross at Dusk

observations.text: Black mourning cord is tied around the east gate posts and every watch bell has been wrapped in cloth.
No armed guard meets the caravan, although the gate stands open.
Kellan's bandaged hands tremble hardest when Maela's wagon amber passes near him.
Maela counts wagons twice while Edrik speaks and never looks toward the barracks.
The barracks shutter splinters lie inside the room despite no opening large enough for an animal.

author_constraints: The party knows the amber chest was present but not yet that blood quickened it.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Harrowcross at Dusk

The first report gives the party a crime scene without a physical entrance and a contract clause Maela is ready to use.

value.title: Maela's Departure

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: Lantern Pike badges remain in Harrowcross. The caravan leaves at the next bell.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: We were hired for twelve wagons.

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: You were hired under a guild bond. The bond transfers you to a paid settlement emergency.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Paid in what? The reeve did not put silver on your table.

turns.speaker: char_2YA8FQRX5Q0PRKSETNQZ4EEDKZ
turns.text: Amber. Three measures from Saint Orra each quarter, plus stamped discs for expenses.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: Raw amber is a protection fee?

turns.speaker: char_2YA8FQRX5Q0PRKSETNQZ4EEDKZ
turns.text: Amber buys most things here. Protection is only the thing we need most often.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: And if we refuse?

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: Your badges, first wages, and return passage are forfeit. More urgently, the east road loses a village tonight.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: You knew before we arrived that you would leave us.

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: I knew the town had sent a red request. I did not know what had answered it.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Go, then. Leave the spare lamp oil and every map east of here.

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: Done. Try to be alive when I come back west.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Maela's Departure

The caravan invokes the emergency clause, reveals that Harrowcross pays Lantern Pike in amber, and leaves the new company behind.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

operations.title: The Party Is Reassigned to Harrowcross
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Party Is Reassigned to Harrowcross

Maela invokes the emergency clause and Hessa accepts the five badges as Harrowcross's replacement watch and investigation detail.

operations.title: The Eastroad Caravan Leaves the Frontiersmen
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Eastroad Caravan Leaves the Frontiersmen

The wagons roll east without ceremony. Maela leaves lamp oil and her annotated road map, but takes the reserve guards and every experienced teamster.

frontmatter.title: Left at Harrowcross

observations.text: The wagon bells diminish eastward while the town's wrapped watch bells remain silent.
Maela's road map has Saint Orra Mine circled twice in different inks.
Hessa's amber tally uses weight marks where mainland contracts would use coin columns.

author_constraints: The party now knows amber pays for guild service, but no one has explained extraction or magical risk.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Left at Harrowcross

The contractual transition is made personal: the old caravan leaves, the new company inherits a frightened town, and amber becomes a debt rather than a curiosity.

recollection.summary: Maela transferred the party under a valid emergency clause and admitted Harrowcross pays in raw amber.
recollection.interpretation: The contract is coercive, but leaving the town undefended would be worse than accepting it.

recollection.summary: Maela knew a red request waited at Harrowcross and brought inexperienced hires anyway.
recollection.interpretation: The guild uses the road to move replaceable bodies toward danger it has already measured.

recollection.summary: Harrowcross pays the guild in amber because protection is its most urgent recurring need.
recollection.interpretation: The settlement's danger and its economy may be the same wound.

recollection.summary: Raw amber is transferred directly from Saint Orra Mine to the guild as payment.
recollection.interpretation: The guild has institutional access to the material it refuses to explain.

recollection.summary: Hessa's ledger measures protection fees by amber weight and Maela was prepared to invoke reassignment.
recollection.interpretation: The Frontier's contracts convert local danger into guild-controlled material flow.

value.title: Kellan's Broken Watch

turns.speaker: char_7DS75TG6WFK6ZD1T9GCBJRMK1T
turns.text: Asha heard the chest humming before Bran cut his hand.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The chest was already warm?

turns.speaker: char_7DS75TG6WFK6ZD1T9GCBJRMK1T
turns.text: Warm enough that the snow beneath it melted. Then Bran's blood ran uphill toward the crack.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: What did the first shape resemble?

turns.speaker: char_7DS75TG6WFK6ZD1T9GCBJRMK1T
turns.text: A deer until it turned its head. Then it had Bran's teeth and Asha's voice.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Did it leave a print? Hair? Blood?

turns.speaker: char_7DS75TG6WFK6ZD1T9GCBJRMK1T
turns.text: Only cold. It went through the wall when Asha struck it.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: And the wall remained a wall.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: We move the chest into the open yard and keep every blade covered.

turns.speaker: char_1F7JEGBD02MVY0J8M9X0967T5T
turns.text: The guild collector forbade moving it before tally.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: The collector is not here.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Kellan's Broken Watch

Kellan supplies the causal sequence the dead guards could not: warm amber, blood moving toward it, and a wretch borrowing familiar anatomy and voices.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

recollection.summary: Asha ordered a spear line after Bran's blood moved toward the humming amber chest. The first wretch wore a deer's body, Bran's teeth, and Asha's voice.
recollection.interpretation: Kellan believes the chest called the thing and that his own survival was accidental rather than brave.

operations.title: The Harrowcross Amber Chest Quickens Again
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Harrowcross Amber Chest Quickens Again

While the company prepares to move the chest, Kellan's bandage opens. A thread of blood creeps against the floor's slope and disappears into the cracked seam. The amber brightens from within and repeats the watch bell's muffled note.

operations.title: A Wretch Comes Through the Barracks Wall
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# A Wretch Comes Through the Barracks Wall

An antlered, dog-limbed shape steps through the north wall without disturbing plaster. Its mouth alternates between Asha's command voice and Bran's laugh. Iron passes through it until Garran's threshold blessing and Veyra's heat force it partly solid.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen Drive Off Their First Wretch
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen Drive Off Their First Wretch

Rhea pins the half-solid creature against the amber chest with Asha's broken spear while Sylvi severs the antler-shadow from its body. Pip rolls the chest into the yard and Veyra smothers the crack under wet charcoal. The wretch collapses into frost and runs as a pale outline through the ground toward the east orchard.

frontmatter.title: First Wretch Night

observations.text: Kellan's blood crawls uphill in a narrow thread toward the cracked amber chest.
An antlered body emerges through intact plaster as though the wall were fog.
The creature says 'hold the line' in the dead corporal's exact command cadence.
The floor dust bends away from the creature but never carries its weight.
The wretch recoils from the threshold prayer as if remembering an older wound.
Every change in the creature's shape follows a pulse from the chest's raw amber.
When the chest leaves the room, the wretch's pale outline flees east through the packed ground.

author_constraints: The party has witnessed correlation, not yet learned the deeper nature of amber.
The dead guards' voices are exact stored impressions, not conscious ghosts.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# First Wretch Night

The story's first direct monster encounter proves that walls and conventional defenses do not define the threat. The party survives by treating the amber chest as part of the battlefield.

operations.title: A Second Wretch Hunts the East Orchard
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# A Second Wretch Hunts the East Orchard

At dawn the party follows frost-rime through the ground to Senna Reed's orchard. A boar-shaped wretch rises beneath a grafted apple tree and repeats the squeal of a pig slaughtered there years earlier. Charcoal-damped amber on Rhea's cloak remains quiet until the creature strikes the tree's fresh sap wound.

operations.title: Tillo Dowses the Quickenings Toward Saint Orra
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# Tillo Dowses the Quickenings Toward Saint Orra

Tillo's copper-bound fork twists away from the damped chest, then pulls east toward the mine road. He identifies the chest as quickened and admits that gnome dowsers locate amber pockets by the pressure they exert on tuned wood and metal.

operations.title: Harrowcross Opens Its Amber Protection Ledger
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# Harrowcross Opens Its Amber Protection Ledger

Hessa produces the town ledger: Saint Orra owes Harrowcross a production share, and Harrowcross transfers the first three measures each quarter to Lantern Pike in exchange for a permanent watch and emergency hunting. The most recent chest mixed raw nodules with struck discs against Tillo's handling rules.

value.title: Tillo and the Fork

turns.speaker: char_6B6FGKREZM4RAECD6ZSFQXX74B
turns.text: Do not bring that chest another step toward my fork.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: You can feel it before you see it.

turns.speaker: char_6B6FGKREZM4RAECD6ZSFQXX74B
turns.text: I can dowse for shallow amber. This is not shallow. This is quick.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Define quick.

turns.speaker: char_6B6FGKREZM4RAECD6ZSFQXX74B
turns.text: Warm without fire. Pulls the fork backward. Makes old shapes where no animal stands.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Old shapes of the dead?

turns.speaker: char_6B6FGKREZM4RAECD6ZSFQXX74B
turns.text: Old shapes. Do not put a soul in the answer because you want one there.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: The outline fled toward the orchard and the mine road.

turns.speaker: char_6B6FGKREZM4RAECD6ZSFQXX74B
turns.text: Then Saint Orra has opened something it should have left sleeping.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: And Harrowcross pays the guild with what the mine wakes.

turns.speaker: char_6B6FGKREZM4RAECD6ZSFQXX74B
turns.text: Yes. That is the Frontier's cleverest circle.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Tillo and the Fork

Tillo gives the party its first operational vocabulary for raw, refined, and quick amber while still withholding the Blackroot Compact.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Tracks in the Orchard

observations.text: A line of white rime travels through buried roots without any print between trees.
Birds feed in the western rows but refuse every branch above the rime line.
The wretch strengthens when fresh tree sap touches amber-colored soil, even without blood.
Tillo's fork pulls toward Saint Orra hard enough to bend its copper binding.

author_constraints: Tillo knows much more than he says and is ashamed of the guild compact.
The party now has a defensible mine lead but not the full metaphysical explanation.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Tracks in the Orchard

The investigation leaves the human crime scene and becomes ecological: the same cold route passes through orchard roots toward the amber mine.

recollection.summary: Tillo calls bloodless warmth, backward dowsing, and bodiless old shapes signs of quick amber; the fork points to Saint Orra.
recollection.interpretation: The mine is the next actionable source even if Tillo is concealing institutional history.

recollection.summary: The wretch trail moves through roots and animal absence rather than across the ground; Tillo's fork confirms the mineward direction.
recollection.interpretation: Amber-bearing ground changes the behavior of the forest before a manifestation appears.

recollection.summary: Tillo refuses to call the old shapes souls and distinguishes a remembered form from a conscious dead person.
recollection.interpretation: The wretches may be repeated suffering without a surviving self to release.

recollection.summary: Gnome dowsing senses amber through pressure on tuned materials, and quick amber creates old shapes without living bodies.
recollection.interpretation: Amber stores or transmits structured impressions rather than ordinary spell energy.

recollection.summary: Harrowcross pays Lantern Pike with amber mined at Saint Orra, and the same material is implicated in the attacks.
recollection.interpretation: The guild's revenue and monster work may be one closed commercial loop.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen Follow the Quickenings to Saint Orra
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen Follow the Quickenings to Saint Orra

Tillo guides the company along the mine road until his fork pulls downward toward the sealed upper drift. Foreman Jorund Bale meets them with a lit yellow-glass lamp and refuses entry before they ask.

value.title: Jorund's Terms

turns.speaker: char_0R5AN25NJFB2GFQPC96JK85SH4
turns.text: The upper drift is closed. Take your guild badges back to town.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Harrowcross lost three guards and two wretches led us to your road.

turns.speaker: char_0R5AN25NJFB2GFQPC96JK85SH4
turns.text: Then kill them outside. My miners are not bait for a lodge report.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y

# Jorund's Terms

Jorund tries to bar the party from the drift while accidentally confirming that the mine has concealed workings and an animal-absence problem.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Saint Orra Mine

observations.text: No bird, hare, or insect crosses the boundary between spruce litter and amber spoil.
The omitted drifts on Jorund's tally correspond to the two places where the ground presses against her teeth.
Fresh knife cuts have removed two drift totals from the official tally board.
The Saint Orra lamp changes from yellow to green whenever Jorund points it toward the sealed drift.
Jorund keeps his lower-drift map inside his coat and one hand on the drift bell rope.

author_constraints: Jorund knows the sealed drift breached a living vein but has not confessed it.
The party is at the threshold of the mine; the cave-in has not yet occurred.
